Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production transparent 2D game sprite sheet for K4RMA parry stagger.
Input 1 is the exact Ward character identity and rendering style reference (three attacking poses; do not include these attacking poses). Input 2 is the original game stage identity sheet; use only its third row Ward form. Input 3 is the chosen C+A pose concept, use only corresponding panel Ward.
Produce ONE horizontal TWO-CELL sheet on genuinely transparent background, no text, no labels, no ground, no dust, no environment. Left cell: neutral standing reference of the SAME stocky wooden bronze-armored guardian. Right cell: deeply staggered pose: torso and helmet hanging forward, knees very deeply bent, near kneeling, heavy weapon pointing DOWN with tip touching common foot baseline, shield drooping at side exposing chest. Visibly dazed, alive, not dead, not attacking. BOTH figures face RIGHT, helmet nose/visor forward toward right edge, same as Input1. Keep sword in image-left hand and shield on image-right side.
Identity MUST remain plain single rectangular slab sword, round shield, navy waistcloth, NO teal cloak, NO pale shoulder crests. Preserve stocky broad armor proportions, huge shoulder rings, small narrow-slit helmet, segmented rounded boots, wooden scratched bronze texture and dark outlines from Input1. No new objects. Do not swap equipment. Neutral and stagger are exact same character drawn at IDENTICAL anatomical scale: helmet, shield diameter, shoulder armor diameter, boot size remain the SAME in pixels in both cells; stagger is SHORTER due to bent knees and torso, NOT scaled up to fill cell. Both feet/weapon-tip baseline at 92% canvas height. Maximum neutral height 85% canvas height, stagger head/shoulder top at about 28-35% canvas height. Keep each entire character inside its own equal half, clear transparent gutter at middle, no cropping.
Stagger armor a little darker (roughly 15-20%), readable colors. Add ONLY a few tiny pale amber-ivory electricity arcs on staggered shoulder, elbow and knee, short local arcs hugging armor, not a halo and not screen-filling. Plain background full ALPHA. Crisp existing hand-painted anime game style, clean anti-aliased cutout. Match existing game assets rather than redesigning.
